ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity (white) pixels dominate approximately 85% of the visible surface area, with low-intensity (black) pixels occupying approximately 15% primarily at the margins and central axis.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white regions occupy the interior of both lobes. Low-intensity black pixels form a continuous border around the entire visible perimeter. A distinct vertical cluster of black pigmentation is present at the base of the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a pixel-depth occupying roughly 20% of the fluke's visible vertical axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitudes ranging from 2 to 15 pixels along the continuous linear boundary of both trailing edges.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curves sweeping outward from the central notch towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast white circular pixel clusters localized on the distal tips of both the left and right lobes, particularly dense on the right lobe tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Four distinct parallel vertical linear disruptions (rake marks) on the lower-left interior lobe. Discrete unaligned linear scratches visible on the right interior lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct parallel vertical scars on the inner-left lobe consistent with high-contrast linear disruptions; localized cluster of circular white marks on distal lobe margins.
